summary: Root entry point for CodexCellEditor webview. Initializes VS Code API, creates 4 context providers (SourceCellContext, UnsavedChangesContext, ScrollToContentContext, TooltipProvider) with memoized values, and mounts the App component. Handles flashing border UI for unsaved changes.

Quill editor initialization in Editor component. Creates Quill instance with snow theme, custom toolbar options, keyboard bindings (list autofill disabled, tab handling), and paste event listeners. Registers custom formats (AutocompleteFormat, FootnoteFormat) as Quill blots.

summary: CellList component renders all translation units as cells. Maps QuillCellContent[] to either CellEditor (edit mode) or CellContentDisplay (read mode). Filters out milestone cells from view but keeps them in JSON. Props include text direction, audio attachments, validation counts, backtranslations, and milestone pagination state.

SourceTextDisplay renders source text with footnote hover tooltips using TooltipContext. Attaches mouseenter/mouseleave listeners to footnote markers (sup.footnote-marker). Updates footnote numbering on mount. Content rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with prose styling.

SourceCellContext: React Context providing sourceCellMap state (cellId -> {content, versions[]}) and setter. Maps cell IDs to source text content and version history. Initialized with memoized value in index.tsx root component.

UnsavedChangesContext: Tracks unsavedChanges (boolean), setUnsavedChanges setter, showFlashingBorder (boolean), toggleFlashingBorder callback. Used to signal dirty state when user edits cells and display visual feedback with flashing border animation.
